capacity:orders.title: Orders can't keep up
capacity:orders.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 3/s and handles 1/s (300%): its backlog only grows.
capacity:orders.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.

dead-letter:queue.title: Queue has no dead-letter queue
dead-letter:queue.message: If Orders and Other can't handle a message, it's dropped after 3 deliveries. A command queue is where losing messages hurts most.
dead-letter:queue.rationale: A message that keeps failing is redelivered up to the broker's delivery limit, then goes to the broker's dead-letter route, or is dropped when there isn't one (or its filter doesn't take the message). A dead-letter queue keeps it to inspect and replay.
